items.item_text: Ability to follow defined program protocols precisely, including distinguishing non-clinical questions from clinical concerns requiring hand-off to licensed staff
A Bachelor's degree in a related area or equivalent experience/training
Experience in case management
Experience as a Patient Navigator
Experience in referral coordination
Experience working with older adults, patients with cognitive impairment, or in neurology or a comparable specialty setting

The Patient Navigator 2 provides non-clinical navigation and coordination for the Alzheimer Therapeutics Program (ATP) within the Neurology Clinic, supporting patients being evaluated for or receiving disease-modifying anti-amyloid therapy. Serving as the primary non-clinical point of contact for patients and care partners, the Navigator guides them through a complex treatment pathway that may include eligibility evaluation and biomarker confirmation, treatment by infusion or injection, required MRI surveillance, and ongoing monitoring.
40% - Referral Coordinator

The Patient Navigator coordinates scheduling, authorizations, medical record retrieval, patient materials, tracking, and communication across Neurology, Neuroradiology, Infusion Services, and Specialty Pharmacy, helping ensure patients progress through required treatment milestones. The position identifies non-clinical needs and barriers to care and routes clinical questions, symptoms, and treatment concerns to the appropriate registered nurse, advanced practice provider, or physician in accordance with program protocols.
20% - Case Conference Coordinator

The Patient Navigator also coordinates and participates in case conferences, administers cognitive testing following required training and certification, and assists with patient submissions to the Alzheimer Disease database. Through consistent communication, coordination, and follow-through, the Navigator plays an important role in helping patients and care partners successfully navigate this specialized treatment program.
5% - Patient Advocate and Care Team Participant
5% - Operational Participant
